item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses an explicit `dspy.ChatAdapter()` and `adapter.format(QA, [], {\"question\": ...})` with the real signature and concrete kwargs."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Precomputes with `[]` demos, matching a fresh `dspy.Predict(QA)` instance whose default demos are empty."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Configures both `lm` and `adapter` via `dspy.configure(...)` and runs `predict(question=...)` through that live path."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Reads the recorded runtime request from `lm.history[-1][\"messages\"]`, which is the LM history payload."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `actual_messages == expected_messages`, giving an exact equivalence check."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Verifies success by asserting `result.answer == \"4\"` from the stubbed `DummyLM` output."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
